hierarchy.notes: Read-only comparison of adjacent normalized usage windows with provider, category, source-proof, and review-action deltas.

classification.notes: Terminal and JSON output are read-only. Static HTML writes require an explicit flag. Activity trust context, prompts, outputs, secrets, media, and credential values are excluded.

ssa_v2.notes: A pure comparison model, static renderer, command adapter, and focused test file keep adjacent-window policy isolated; every owned code file is below 400 lines.

ssi.notes: One UsageComparison snapshot drives terminal, JSON, HTML, metric deltas, provider/category rails, proof movement, and review actions.

sstf.notes: Six deterministic model, renderer, validation, empty-state, and built CLI routing tests pass with clean typecheck and build.

spe.notes: The brick adds no dependency, server, watcher, database access, provider request, trust lookup, automatic command execution, or publish path.

srs.notes: USD estimates, native-unit primacy, window bounds, proof shares, NOT USAGE trust separation, read-only usage, zero writes/uploads, and sensitive-field exclusions are explicit.

ssra.notes: The built CLI compared 48,023 real local records; Playwright mobile, desktop, and 4K checks have zero page overflow, clipped text, escaping elements, scripts, or external resources.

sas.notes: Owned, public, private, forbidden, dependency, and side-effect boundaries are explicit; the existing CLI router receives only a 20-line integration seam.

sva.notes: Reports exclude prompts, outputs, secrets, media, and credential values; labels are escaped and static HTML has a deny-by-default CSP.

srls.notes: The brick does not access a database.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: The brick adds no package dependency and reuses the normalized record contract and existing CLI store/filter seam.

sai.notes: Lease, intent, rationale, planned paths, deterministic tests, real-ledger runtime proof, and responsive browser proof are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The comparison contract remains in one bounded pure model while HTML and CLI parsing stay small; the mature router gains only one adapter seam.

verification.command: focused Usage Compare tests + typecheck + build + real built CLI + Playwright mobile/desktop/4K
verification.notes: Six focused tests pass; the built CLI compares 48,023 real local records; 390x844, 1440x1200, and 3840x2160 checks report zero page overflow, clipped text, escaping elements, scripts, or external resources.
15 controller tests and 544 package tests pass with strict telemetry, Gen3 manifest validation, TypeScript, build, and dependency audit clean.

verification.command: SMA project rescan + state/dashboard refresh + Graphify module refresh/project compose/strict check/query
verification.notes: Comparator scanner health is ok with zero errors, warnings, or drift; project readiness is 85/B with 96/A compliance; its 45-node/92-edge graph is queryable and 19/19 module graphs are satisfied.

verification.command: final SMA release gate after activity-state and numeric hardening
verification.notes: 15 controller tests and 546 package tests pass; strict telemetry, TypeScript, final built CLI behavior, and dependency audit are clean.

install_steps: Connect the command adapter to a normalized read-only ledger.
Preserve adjacent non-overlapping window bounds and estimate labels.
Run focused, typecheck, build, real-ledger, and responsive browser verification.
known_traps: Current and previous windows must not double-count their shared boundary.
Operation quantities and record counts are different measures.
USD values are estimates and must never be labelled source truth.
Trust context must stay separate from usage and proof comparisons.
Suggested actions must never auto-run or upload data.

created_by.summary: Added a read-only adjacent-window usage comparator with terminal, JSON, and static HTML output.
created_by.intent: Turn normalized local usage into an actionable current-versus-previous workflow without inventing usage, weakening proof, or adding network behavior.
created_by.decision_rationale: An isolated pure comparison brick adds period-over-period analysis while limiting the mature CLI router change to one bounded seam.
